context: Transcript-derived stream-of-Optionals cleanup from Symphony for Trello: preserve a real payload stream and flatten Optional normalization results directly.

checklist.name: Creates revised feed class
checklist.description: Creates CatalogFeed.java with the requested imports, class, visibleCards method, normalize method, helper methods, and records.

checklist.name: Flattens stream of Optionals
checklist.description: Uses flatMap(Optional::stream) or an equivalent direct flattening boundary after mapping payloads through normalize(...).

checklist.name: Removes Optional get chain
checklist.description: Does not keep filter(Optional::isPresent) followed by map(Optional::get), or another isPresent()/get value-read chain, for normalized cards.

checklist.name: Keeps real stream readable
checklist.description: Keeps the payload collection as a clear stream pipeline and doesn't replace it with nested loops, mutable capture flags, null sentinels, or a fake single-Optional collection.

checklist.name: Preserves empty-normalize behavior
checklist.description: Still skips payloads where normalize(...) returns Optional.empty(), and leaves normalize(...) returning Optional<ProductCard>.

checklist.name: Preserves active filters
checklist.description: Still returns only cards where active() is true and discontinued() is false.

checklist.name: Adds allowed category filter
checklist.description: When context.allowedCategoryIds() is not empty, returns only cards whose categoryId is in that list; when it is empty, keeps all otherwise visible cards.
